review: Aurora merged the 2026-11-07 Horizon nightly (6560641), not the moving main branch. Followed upstream's restructure: the game is the horizon-client library with horizon-client-lib below it, the Android host lives in horizon-client (android_host) and crates/horizon-android keeps only the native entry points and the DocumentsProvider exports. WebAssembly code mods are dropped as upstream did; content mods and the bundled native mods remain. Taken from upstream: terrain passes, GPU timing, panorama, audio probing, extras and graphics screens, zip 9. Kept for Android: compatibility mode, GLES entity shader and base-vertex fallback, surface suspension, the startup renderer worker, per-session ownership, HUD insets, keypad and touch input, Horizon Boost thermal limits. Newly arrived upstream workflows are stored disabled under .github/upstream-workflows. ARM64 cargo check and Clippy (-D warnings) and the Android source checks passed; device testing of this merge, other ABIs and GLES devices is still pending.

accounts_appearance_review.notes: Reviewed newer account-save reporting and desktop encrypted-file storage changes. Android retains its Keystore AES/GCM store and reports sign-in save failures through the existing shared task. The selected stable nightly baseline is unchanged; no experimental UI branches were merged.

android_stability_review.notes: Reviewed the current upstream loading handoff: it still leaks its resource owner for the process lifetime and has no Android lifecycle or GLES preparation path to transplant. Retained the Android baseline; this change owns resources per session, publishes background pause without redraws, and keeps native events flowing during exclusive GLES world preparation. No upstream deployment workflows were enabled.
